blocks.title: Key vocabulary
items: ROM — Non-volatile storage for relatively fixed code.
virtual storage — Remote/pooled physical storage presented logically.
virtual memory — OS memory abstraction using paging.

blocks.title: Understand
blocks.text: RAM holds currently used programs/data and normally loses content without power; ROM or firmware flash retains startup routines.

blocks.title: Apply
blocks.text: OCR virtual storage means logical storage presented from physically remote or pooled devices, such as a network drive or cloud service.

blocks.title: Evaluate
blocks.text: Do not confuse virtual storage with virtual memory. Virtual memory uses secondary storage to extend the apparent addressable memory of processes; virtual storage is remote-file presentation.

blocks.title: Worked example · Explain the choice
blocks.text: On one or more remote network storage devices, even if Finder/Explorer shows a drive like local storage.
